claim: Give hooks a private stack in the mapped hook page, or make them stackless, so dead game-stack bytes do not differ in whole-RAM comparisons.

evidence.text: A private stack inside the mapped hook page removes dead game-stack residue; full 48K native comparison then needs no stack exclusions.
A hook that CALLs on the game's stack changes dead bytes visible in lockstep; the hide hooks were made stackless.
